title: Dia Browser
description: Sunlit cream: a warm off-white page with near-black ink, one pure-black pill CTA, near-white pills and black-8% hairlines, and a single burst of gold and butter yellow reserved for the hero. A sharp, tightly tracked text serif for headings over a neo-grotesk, with an uppercase grotesk mono for small print. Dark is the same at dusk: warm charcoal, cream type and cream pills, the gold turned amber under pale butter light.
notes: highlight (gold) and glow (butter) are the hero backdrop gradient; use them sparingly elsewhere
Newsreader stands in for Exposure (closed), Hanken Grotesk for ABC Oracle (closed), DM Mono for ABC Favorit Mono (closed)
name: diabrowser-theme
